plain: The default graphite accent is a touch lighter in light mode and a touch softer in dark mode; re-take accent screenshots, and opt into the new cobalt accent with data-accent="cobalt" on <html> if you want it.

steps.plain: The light-mode accent fill and accent text (graphite.700) is now #4a4146 (was #433a3f); white text on it is 9.83:1.
The dark-mode accent fill (graphite.200) is now #cbc6c9 (was #d4d0d2); its on-accent text is 9.02:1.
